<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

    <line x1="20" y1="56" x2="35" y2="48" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <g id="intro">
    <text x="20" y="108" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Everyday idioms</text>
    <text x="20" y="130" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12.94" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Learn the meaning behind the words.</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="145" width="350" height="42" rx="8" fill="#F0F0F0"/>
      <circle cx="41" cy="165" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#45413C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="46" y1="170" x2="52" y2="176" stroke="#45413C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="64" y="170" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6E7191">Search phrases</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="197" width="76" height="28" rx="8" fill="#000000"/>
      <text x="58" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">All</text>

      <text x="149" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Work</text>
      <rect x="203" y="197" width="93" height="28" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="249" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Feelings</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <g id="phrase-list">
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="242" width="350" height="91" rx="8" fill="#F0F0F0"/>
      <text x="34" y="266" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="18.28" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Break the ice</text>
      <text x="34" y="288" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">To make people feel more comfortable</text>
      <text x="34" y="311" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">“A quick game helped us</text>
      <text x="194" y="311" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FF6242">break the ice.”</text>
      <rect x="315" y="256" width="39" height="22" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="334" y="271" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FF6242">A1</text>
    </g>
    <line x1="20" y1="345" x2="370" y2="345" stroke="#F0F0F0" stroke-width="1"/>

    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="355" width="350" height="91" rx="8" fill="#FFF6D6"/>
      <text x="34" y="379" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="18.28" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Hit the nail on the head</text>
      <text x="34" y="401" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">To describe something exactly right</text>
      <text x="34" y="424" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">“You</text>
      <text x="68" y="424" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FF6242">hit the nail on the head</text>
      <text x="236" y="424" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">with that answer.”</text>
      <rect x="315" y="369" width="39" height="22" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="334" y="384" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FF6242">A2</text>
    </g>
    <line x1="20" y1="458" x2="370" y2="458" stroke="#F0F0F0" stroke-width="1"/>

    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="468" width="350" height="91" rx="8" fill="#F0F0F0"/>
      <text x="34" y="492" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="18.28" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">A piece of cake</text>
      <text x="34" y="514" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Something that is very easy to do</text>
      <text x="34" y="537" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">“The first part of the quiz was</text>
      <text x="237" y="537" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FF6242">a piece of cake.”</text>
      <rect x="315" y="482" width="39" height="22" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="334" y="497" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FF6242">A2</text>
    </g>
    <line x1="20" y1="571" x2="370" y2="571" stroke="#F0F0F0" stroke-width="1"/>

    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="581" width="350" height="91" rx="8" fill="#FFF6D6"/>
      <text x="34" y="605" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="18.28" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Under the weather</text>
      <text x="34" y="627" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">To feel ill or not quite yourself</text>
      <text x="34" y="650" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">“I’m feeling</text>
      <text x="111" y="650" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FF6242">under the weather</text>
      <text x="247" y="650" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">today.”</text>
      <rect x="315" y="595" width="39" height="22" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="334" y="610" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FF6242">B1</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <g id="navigation">

      <circle cx="126" cy="773" r="13" fill="#FF6242"/>

      <line x1="126" y1="766" x2="126" y2="780" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="126" y="806" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FF6242">Learn</text>

    <g>

    </g>
    <g>

      <line x1="343" y1="773" x2="357" y2="773" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="343" y1="779" x2="357" y2="779" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="350" y="806" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">More</text>
    </g>
